name: Anshu Kondru
testimony:
I once crashed a moving bus after getting up. I asked God why He didn’t help me. Then, the Holy Spirit of God within me asked, “Do you have any scratches on your body? What about your phone?”

My phone had fallen two feet away from me, yet it didn’t have a single scratch. What surprised me most was that my heartbeat remained at a constant pace. It wasn’t racing, and I wasn’t afraid.

Even today, I am not afraid to ride my bike again. I saw Psalm 91 manifest in my life.
